content:
Footer

Configure footer text that appears at the bottom of payslips.

Use footers to add terms, conditions, or additional information to payslips.

Name

Enter a name to identify this footer. This name will appear in dropdown menus when selecting a footer for payslips.

Content

Enter the content that will appear at the bottom of payslips. You can include HR contact details, company policies, or any other employee information.

Inactive

Mark this footer as inactive to prevent it from appearing in footer selection dropdowns. Existing payslips using this footer will not be affected.
